fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU) surged 272.9% YTD (vs. S&P 500's 11.5%), achieving fiscal Q4 2026 revenue of $54.2 billion on AI chip demand, up 379% from prior year's $11.3 billion.
fields.summary_ko.1: Net income grew faster than revenue, reaching $85.0 billion annually (vs. prior year's $8.54 billion, a 10x increase), with operating margin expanding to 80.7%; however, the stock fell 22.4% since September.
fields.summary_ko.2: PER on book value basis is 11.1x versus S&P 500's 22.8x, indicating undervaluation, but PSR on revenue basis stands at 9.0x, up from 5.0x a year ago.
